recognize_zh: 血液抹片中紅血球大小不一，散在多個頭盔狀與三角形碎片的裂紅血球（schistocytes，黑色箭頭），另有鋸齒狀細胞，血小板稀少；藍色箭頭處一個紅血球旁有圓形深藍色核狀物，對應描述中的正在脫核紅血球。大量裂紅血球配合血小板低與腎衰竭，符合血栓性微血管病變（Shiga 毒素相關 HUS）。
features: Anisocytosis with numerous schistocytes, including helmet cells, triangular fragments and keratocytes (black arrow)
Scattered crenated/spiculated red cell fragments and occasional small dense cells
Dark blue round nuclear body closely apposed to a red cell (blue arrow), consistent with a nucleus being extruded from a nucleated RBC
Paucity of platelets in the field, compatible with thrombocytopenia
Thin rod-shaped extracellular artifacts/stain debris in the background; no leukocytes in the field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisocytosis with numerous schistocytes per high-power field, including helmet cells, triangular fragments and keratocytes, together with crenated fragmented forms. A red cell with an adjacent dense blue round nucleus is present, interpreted as a nucleus being extruded from a nucleated red cell. Platelets are sparse, and occasional linear stain precipitates are present as artifact. Findings are consistent with a thrombotic microangiopathy with microangiopathic hemolytic anemia, in keeping with the reported Shiga toxin 2-induced hemolytic uremic syndrome; ADAMTS13 activity should be measured to exclude TTP.

ddx.vs: TTP shows an identical schistocyte-rich smear, so severe ADAMTS13 deficiency (<10%) rather than morphology separates it from STEC-HUS.
aHUS is morphologically indistinguishable and is diagnosed by negative STEC testing, normal ADAMTS13 and complement studies or genetic testing.
DIC can produce schistocytes but is accompanied by prolonged PT/aPTT, low fibrinogen and elevated D-dimer, which are usually normal or near-normal in HUS.
Valve-related fragmentation lacks thrombocytopenia and renal failure, and burns produce microspherocytes and budding fragments with a clear clinical history.
